reason: You want me to export my whole work chat, with contractor bank details, guest names and everything else people say in there, and hand it to a bot I've never heard of, then link it to my Google account. No. And my admin already reconciles the transfer screenshots, so I'm not paying $19 a month to hand that risk to a stranger.
objection: I have no idea who is behind @NotaGetBot or where my chat archive ends up. Once it's sent I can't take it back, and that chat holds far more than receipts.
would_change_my_mind: A way to forward only the receipts myself, with no chat export and no adding the bot to the group, plus a named company I can check that promises in writing to delete the files after processing.
